attributes.during: The first time a villain is defeated, do not to check to see if it escapes; instead, display it next to the scenario. When the other villain is defeated and cornered, banish it, then put the displayed villain on top of your location deck; a character at your location immediately encounters it. To win the scenario, defeat the first villain again.
